# jsPDF 4.2.1

Pinned browser UMD build from the official parallax/jsPDF v4.2.1 tag.
Used only for local vector PDF generation. The site does not use its HTML,
remote-image, file-read, annotation-color or embedded-JavaScript APIs.

- Source: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF/tree/v4.2.1
- Browser file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parallax/jsPDF/v4.2.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js
- SHA-256: e6551fcdc32f09d6853b2c5126d18d01d9447e0da618a41a11ebeee0f6c20d54
- License: MIT; retained in LICENSE and in the complete offline HTML.
- Loaded from this site only on PDF request; embedded in saved HTML so
  regenerating a booklet offline needs no network or third-party CDN.

Reviewed November 3, 2026. This import adds no schedule or automatic updater.
